info.title: S3MINI API
info.description:
OpenAPI description of the HTTP APIs implemented by S3MINI: its S3-compatible
subset, dashboard/control-plane routes, OIDC browser login, and authenticated
peer replication routes. This document is public at GET /api. It describes
implemented behavior, not full AWS S3 compatibility. Some S3 operations
share a path and are selected by query parameters as documented below.

tags.name: S3 Objects
tags.description: Implemented S3 object and multipart operations.

get.description: Requires an OIDC dashboard role when OIDC is configured; otherwise serves the dashboard.

302.description: Redirect to /admin/login when the browser has no OIDC session.

get.summary: Begin the OIDC authorization-code flow with PKCE

302.description: Redirect to the configured OIDC provider.

get.summary: Complete OIDC login and set the dashboard session cookie

302.description: Redirect to /admin and set an HttpOnly session cookie.

get.description: Requires at least the viewer role, an accepted admin bearer token, or a test-only dashboard cookie.
Requires the admin role. Revoked role tombstones are not included.

200.description: Dashboard users and their assigned roles.

put.description: Requires the admin role. Role changes are asynchronously replicated to peers.

delete.description: Requires the admin role. Revocation is retained and replicated as a tombstone.

get.description: Requires viewer role. Secret access keys are never returned by this operation.

post.description: Requires operator role. The secret is returned only at creation time.

delete.description: Requires operator role. Disabling an access key is irreversible through this API.

200.description: Policy document or an empty object.

post.description: Requires operator role; requeues the specified event.

put.description:
Internal peer endpoint for object writes and delete events. Requires the configured
replication token. For DeleteObject events, omit the binary body; for PutObject,
supply the object bytes. This endpoint is not intended for application clients.
Internal authenticated and idempotent peer bucket creation.
Internal authenticated peer update of a dashboard role, including revoked tombstones.

get.description: Internal authenticated inventory used for peer anti-entropy repair.
S3 ListBuckets. Uses Signature Version 4 or an OIDC bearer token when configured; anonymous access can be allowed depending on server configuration.

get.summary: List bucket contents or get a bucket subresource
get.description:
Without a recognized operation query, lists objects (ListObjectsV2 by default;
list-type=1 selects the legacy ListObjects response). Query options select bucket
subresources: location, versioning, tagging, acl, cors, lifecycle, policy,
encryption, website, logging, notification, replication, uploads, or versions.

put.summary: Create a bucket or update its configuration
put.description: Creates the bucket or configures versioning, tags, ACL, CORS, lifecycle, policy, encryption, website, logging, notification, or replication by supplying the corresponding query flag.

delete.summary: Delete a bucket or its configuration
delete.description: Deletes the bucket, or deletes its tagging/configuration when tagging, cors, lifecycle, policy, encryption, website, logging, notification, replication, or acl is supplied.

post.description: S3 multi-object delete operation; requires the delete query flag and an XML body with object keys.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Object key. This route accepts slash-separated keys as a greedy path.

get.summary: Get an object or object subresource
get.description: Gets object bytes, object tags/ACL (tagging or acl query), or multipart-upload parts (uploadId query). Supports versionId and HTTP conditional/range headers.

put.summary: Store an object or upload a multipart part
put.description: Stores/replaces an object, copies an object when x-amz-copy-source is supplied, uploads a multipart part with uploadId and partNumber, or updates object tags/ACL with the corresponding query flag. Supports user metadata and supported S3/B2 headers.

200.description: Object, copy, ACL/tag, or multipart part result.

delete.summary: Delete an object or object subresource
delete.description: Deletes an object/version, aborts multipart upload with uploadId, or deletes tags with tagging.

204.description: Object, version, tags, or multipart upload deleted.

post.summary: Run a multipart or object operation
post.description: Initiates a multipart upload with uploads; completes one with uploadId and an XML parts body; or invokes select with select, restore with restore, or multi-delete when routed at the bucket path.

options.description: Evaluates the configured bucket CORS rule for an OPTIONS preflight.

204.description: CORS preflight allowed; CORS response headers are returned.

SigV4.name: Authorization
SigV4.description: AWS Signature Version 4 Authorization header using an active S3MINI access key.

OidcBearer.description: OIDC provider token. S3 operations require s3:read, s3:write, or s3:admin scopes; s3:* and * grant all scopes.

AdminBearer.description: S3MINI_ADMIN_TOKEN or an active OIDC bearer token with s3:admin scope. Dashboard authorization also accepts configured OIDC roles.

DashboardCookie.name: s3mini_oidc_token
DashboardCookie.description: HttpOnly browser session cookie established by the OIDC login flow; role must satisfy the operation's minimum role.

ReplicationToken.name: x-s3mini-replication-token
ReplicationToken.description: Must match S3MINI_REPLICATION_TOKEN. Replication routes return 403 if the setting is absent or does not match.

secretAccessKey.description: Returned only when the key is created.

AccessDenied.description: Authentication is missing, invalid, or lacks the required role/scope.
